input.quote: iii. Licensor hereby, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement and provided that Licensee makes payments to Licensor as required under this Agreement, grants to Licensee a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use and subject to the additional restrictions set forth below and otherwise in this License Agreement.
input.rationale:
The Article II grant (p0030) runs to Licensee alone, and restriction (e) (p0045) bars use or access by "any individuals other than the employees of the Licensee". Affiliates are defined (1.1) but never brought within the grant, and contractors acting on our behalf are excluded outright; the only route to add them is Licensor's discretionary prior written consent (p0041, p0027, p0085), which is not the fallback's "affiliates covered on written notice". That fails the fallback on a material term and sits close to walk-away territory (affiliates and contractors excluded with no reliable path to add them). The redline makes the smallest edit to the preferred position: adding Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf to the grant and to restriction (e), with Licensee responsible for their compliance. Noted but not separately flagged: the licence is not revocable at Licensor's will, and successor transfer is partially addressed via the Change of Control provision (p0134/p0149), where Licensor's consent may not be unreasonably withheld — that is roughly at the fallback for M&A transfer, and the immediate-termination-for-any-breach right in Article IV (p0049) is better addressed under the termination rule.</rationale>
<parameter name="confidence">0.82

proposal.summary: Extend the licence grant to Licensee's Affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need the licence to reach our Affiliates and the contractors who operate the Platform on our behalf; as drafted the grant runs to Licensee alone and use is confined to our employees, with access for anyone else available only at Licensor's discretion. We have added Affiliates and contractors to the grant and the corresponding restriction, and remain responsible for their compliance. If Licensor prefers, we can accept Affiliate coverage on written notice to Licensor instead.

ops.oldText: grants to Licensee a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use
ops.newText: grants to Licensee, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use (with Licensee remaining responsible for each such Affiliate's and contractor's compliance with this Agreement)

ops.oldText: any individuals other than the employees of the Licensee for use in the Field of Use.
ops.newText: any individuals other than the employees of the Licensee, of its Affiliates and of its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf, in each case for use in the Field of Use.
